mostWorthwhile.text: The quiet moment in the receiving laboratory was the most worthwhile passage: the folded limbs finally reach another pair of hands, and the silence leaves room for their significance.

leastWorthwhile.text: Nothing in this short ending felt especially repetitive or confusing.

surprise.text: The ending moves directly from departure to the receiving laboratory, without explaining what the specimen is.

arbitrary.text: There were no gameplay actions in this chapter to judge.

continue.text: I would be curious to see what the laboratory learns about the specimens, although the supplied story ends here.
